notes.title: Update Notes for November 13
notes.content:
This small patch addresses a few progression blockers that were present in both the Desert and Jungle biomes

[list]
[*] Bottom right green cube in the Desert Level 9 Puzzle 1 can now properly move up
[*] Top right yellow cube in the Jungle Level 11 Puzzle 2 has been replaced by a hollow yellow cube, allowing the player to collect all available stars in the puzzle
[/list]

notes.title: Post release quick fix
notes.content: A small fix was pushed to address an issue where any unlocked submarine could not be interacted with properly, preventing the player from navigating to another biome.
